column1: # Preferential runway assignments.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# Most busy airports do not simply use the runway with the best headwind. They
# have a preferential configuration driven by noise abatement
# flow and the direction most instrument approaches are built for. San Francisco
# lands west in calm wind
